title: 江城子·密州出猎
titlePy: Jiāng Chéng Zǐ · Mìzhōu Chū Liè
titleEn: River Town: Out Hunting at Mizhou
author: 苏轼
intro: Hounds, falcons, a thousand riders and a governor who wants to shoot a tiger himself. Su Shi’s loud, swaggering hunting song — and a wish to be sent to fight on the frontier.
analysis: 这首词写苏轼在密州当太守时一次打猎的场面。上阕写出猎：我这个老头子姑且也发一回少年人的狂劲，左手牵着黄狗，右臂托着苍鹰，随从们戴着锦帽、穿着貂皮衣，上千人马像风一样卷过平坦的山冈。为了报答全城百姓跟着来看热闹，我要像当年的孙权一样，亲自射杀老虎。下阕写抱负：喝足了酒，胸怀更加开阔，鬓角有点白了，又有什么关系！什么时候朝廷能像汉文帝派冯唐去云中那样，派人来重新任用我呢？到那时，我要把雕弓拉得像满月一样圆，朝西北方向，射下天狼星。“天狼”比喻当时威胁北宋边境的西夏和辽。这首词节奏快、气势大，一扫当时词多写儿女情长的风气，被看作豪放词的开山之作之一。
analysisEn: Su Shi was governor of Mizhou when he led this hunt. The first half is the hunt itself. “This old man,” he says, “will let loose a young man’s wildness for once”: a yellow hound on a leash in his left hand, a grey falcon on his right arm, his men in brocade hats and sable furs, a thousand horsemen sweeping over the flat ridge like a gust of wind. The whole town has come out to watch, so to thank them he will shoot the tiger himself, like the young warlord Sun Quan centuries before. The second half moves from the hunt to his ambitions. Warmed by wine, he feels bold and big-hearted; a little white at the temples — so what? He then borrows a Han-dynasty story: an emperor once sent the old official Feng Tang to Yunzhong with a pardon for a disgraced frontier general. When, Su Shi asks, will someone be sent to call me back to serve? Then he would draw his carved bow round as a full moon, face northwest, and shoot down the Wolf Star — Sirius, a traditional symbol of invaders, here meaning the Western Xia and Liao states threatening the Song border. Fast, loud and proud, the poem broke with the soft love songs most ci were in those days, and is counted among the first works of the “bold and unrestrained” style.
background: Su Shi (1037–1101), also called Su Dongpo, was sent out of the capital after disagreeing with Wang Anshi’s reforms. He wrote this in 1075, aged about 38, as governor of Mizhou (in today’s Shandong), on a hunt on the way back from praying for rain at Mount Chang.
pronunciation: 少年 shào nián；千骑 qiān jì（骑兵，不读 qí）；为报 wèi bào；冯唐 Féng Táng（姓冯读 féng）；擎 qíng；貂裘 diāo qiú；鬓 bìn。“看孙郎”的“看”现代读 kàn，按词律此处为平声，旧读 kān，网站暂注 kàn。
version: 采用通行教材版本，无重要异文。“鬓微霜，又何妨”句末有的版本用问号。

lines.py: lǎo fū liáo fā shào nián kuáng
lines.lit: This old man for a while lets out a youth’s wildness:
lines.en: Old as I am, I’ll be wild as a young man today —

lines.py: zuǒ qiān huáng, yòu qíng cāng
lines.lit: on the left leading a yellow hound, on the right holding up a grey falcon;
lines.en: a yellow hound on the leash, a grey falcon on my arm;

lines.py: jǐn mào diāo qiú, qiān jì juǎn píng gāng
lines.lit: brocade hats and sable coats, a thousand riders sweep the flat ridge.
lines.en: in brocade caps and sable furs, a thousand riders roll across the ridge.

lines.py: wèi bào qīng chéng suí tài shǒu
lines.lit: To repay the whole city for following the governor,
lines.en: The whole town has come out behind their governor —

lines.py: qīn shè hǔ, kàn sūn láng
lines.lit: I will shoot the tiger myself — watch young Sun!
lines.en: so I’ll shoot the tiger myself, like young Sun Quan of old.

lines.py: jiǔ hān xiōng dǎn shàng kāi zhāng
lines.lit: Flushed with wine, my heart and courage open still wider;
lines.en: The wine has warmed me; my heart feels wide and brave.

lines.py: bìn wēi shuāng, yòu hé fáng
lines.lit: temples slightly frosted — what harm is there?
lines.en: A little frost at my temples — what of it!

lines.py: chí jié yún zhōng, hé rì qiǎn féng táng
lines.lit: Holding the imperial tally to Yunzhong — on what day will Feng Tang be sent?
lines.en: When will the court send its envoy, as it once sent Feng Tang, to call me back?

lines.py: huì wǎn diāo gōng rú mǎn yuè
lines.lit: I shall draw the carved bow like a full moon,
lines.en: Then I’ll bend my carved bow round as the full moon,

lines.py: xī běi wàng, shè tiān láng
lines.lit: look to the northwest, and shoot the Wolf Star.
lines.en: turn to the northwest, and shoot down the Wolf Star.

words.en: this old man (speaker referring to himself)
words.note: 老年人的自称；苏轼当时不到四十岁，是自嘲。

words.en: for a while; just for once
words.note: 古义“姑且”，如“聊以自慰”；现代口语“聊天”的“聊”意思不同。
骑：一人一马，读 jì；动词“骑马”读 qí。
这里指全城的人；“倾城倾国”是形容女子极美，不同。

words.en: young Sun — Sun Quan, Three Kingdoms ruler
words.note: 孙权曾骑马亲自射虎，这里苏轼以孙权自比。
现代汉语说“酒喝得正痛快”；“酣睡”“酣畅”也用“酣”。

words.en: to carry the imperial tally (as an envoy)

words.note: 汉文帝派冯唐持节到云中，赦免了守边的魏尚；苏轼盼望朝廷也这样重新起用自己。
表示将来一定，现代汉语“会”也有这个用法。
现代汉语“挽弓”少用，“挽救”“挽留”还常用。
古人认为天狼星主侵略，这里比喻西北的西夏和辽。

imagery.name: 马
imagery.zh: “千骑卷平冈”，上千人马奔驰，写出打猎的声势和豪气。
imagery.en: A thousand horsemen sweeping the ridge: the noise and swagger of the hunt.

imagery.name: 酒
imagery.zh: 酒后胸怀更开阔，引出报国的豪情。
imagery.en: Wine opens his heart and leads into his dream of serving his country.

imagery.name: 霜
imagery.zh: “鬓微霜”指鬓角发白，诗人却说年老不碍事。
imagery.en: Frost at the temples means greying hair — which he shrugs off.

imagery.name: 月
imagery.zh: 把弓拉得像满月，写出力量和决心。
imagery.en: A bow drawn round as a full moon shows his strength and resolve.

imagery.name: 星
imagery.zh: 天狼星比喻侵犯边境的敌人，射天狼就是保卫国家。
imagery.en: The Wolf Star stands for the invaders; shooting it means defending the country.
